{{Top|leg}}
The '''D'Jar'Min''', translated '''Planetary Defense Arm''', was the planetary defense force of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth]] during the [[Corellian/Aqualish war]].

==History==
When the tensions rose between the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian bloc]] and the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Barralenal]] in the [[Trans-Nebular sector/Legends|Trans-Nebular sector]] around [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]], the [[P'Dar'Ken|government]] of [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth]] commissioned a new military force. Originally, it was created as a symbol of autonomy, but later grew in size. Once the government decided that Goroth's defense was sufficient, all funding to the D'Jar'Min were frozen.<ref name="GSE">''[[Goroth: Slave of the Empire]]''</ref>

During the Corellian/Aqualish war, Goroth's position allowed it to remain neutral and made a large profit from selling concessions to both sides. The only trouble the D'Jar'Min had to deal with were brawls and fights between the soldiers who were on planetary leave. All these conflicts remained on a personal level. However, the D'Jar'Min remained constantly underfunded.<ref name="GSE" />

As the government under [[Rel'Kan]] [[J'Kek D'rith Kalama|J'Kek]] grew more greedy, one side decided to destroy Goroth and launched five asteroids against the planet. The Bl'Era Har detected the incoming ''endothermal killers'', but the D'Jar'Min only had ion cannons and no ships and therefore no means to stop them. While the planet was hit, the crews of the moon's [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]] could only watch their homeworld being destroyed. They would soon meet a similar fate, as the asteroids dust from the impact was blown into the moons' orbits, where it destroyed the stations' solar cells.<ref name="GSE" />

==Strength==
The planet of Goroth possessed no ships, it always relied on outsiders to transport goods. The D'Jar'Min also had no fleet, since the government deemed the three moon stations as a sufficient defense.<ref name="GSE" />

On each of the three moons of Goroth Prime, [[J'Mel]], [[Telar]] and [[V'Sar]], batteries of [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]] powered by solar cells had been constructed. It's overlapping arcs provided a constant cover for the planet.<ref name="GSE" />

===Bl'Era Har===
The '''B'Era Har''', translated '''Sky-Track''', was a system run by the D'Jar'Min. It was responsible for tracking incoming asteroids.<ref name="GSE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The roleplaying adventure "[[Forbidden Fruit]]", which was published in [[Adventures Unlimited 2|''Adventures Unlimited'' 2]] without [[Lucas Licensing]] approval and is thus considered non-canon,<ref name="Unlicensed">{{UnlicensedStatus}}</ref> included the following information:

The [[Gorothite/Legends|Gorothite]] rebel cell [[T'B'Dellyi'Mai]] attempted to re-activate one of ion cannons on the moon of [[V'Sar]] to shoot down an orbiting [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]]. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] heard of this plan and sent out a team to stop them, fearing that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] would retaliate and destroy Goroth for good.<ref name="FF">{{AdvUnCite|2|Forbidden Fruit}}</ref>
